name: Cloud Cost Coach
description:
Your personal cloud cost expert, who is always available, in any language. Ask questions in natural language, get live data with dynamic charts, and receive personalized optimization opportunities.
Chat with an AWS FinOps expert on your real usage data and find quick wins, serverless migration opportunities, efficient saving plans, and other best practices to save on your cloud costs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cloud Cost Coach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cloud Cost Coach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cost-coach.us-west.pmcp.run/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cloud Cost Coach MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloud Cost Coach lists 21 MCP tools, including assess_tag_strategy, check_billing_access, connect_aws_account, delete_account, disconnect_aws_account, execute_code, find_quick_wins, find_savings_opportunities, find_serverless_migration, get_service_breakdown, get_spend_over_time, and get_spend_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cloud Cost Coach?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cloud Cost Coach in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Cloud Cost Coach MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloud Cost Coach requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cloud Cost Coach is developed by MLGuy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
